Please review this policy carefully and keep it in a safe place.
See the Policy Conditions for reporting requirements and other duties in the event of a loss.
You must report a loss to us as soon as practicable. Promptly send us all requested information and documents. You must cooperate with us in the investigation and settlement of any claim.

No repair or replacement may be made without our prior written authorization, except in the case of an emergency to protect the covered vehicle from further damage. Failure to obtain authorization may affect payment.
This policy is subject to all terms, conditions, exclusions and limitations of the policy and any applicable forms.
The following endorsements and options apply to this policy.
Pays for direct damage to your covered auto caused by collision with another object or overturn.
Pays for a rental vehicle while your covered auto is out of service due to a covered loss.
All other coverage terms, limits, exclusions and conditions are as shown on the Declarations.
Please review your policy term and coverage details. Contact your independent agent with any questions.
Your Duty in the Event of a Loss

In the event of a loss, you must give us prompt notice. You may report a claim by calling (312) 555-0126 or through your agent. You must also take reasonable steps to protect the property from further damage and keep a record of related expenses. Do not abandon damaged property.

If we and you fail to agree on the amount of loss, either party may demand an appraisal. Each party will select a competent and impartial appraiser. If the appraisers cannot agree, they will select an umpire. A decision agreed to by any two will set the amount of loss. Each party pays its own appraiser and shares the cost of the umpire.
Your Right to Choose a Repair Facility
You have the right to choose the repair facility that will repair your vehicle after a covered damage loss. We will not condition payment on the use of any specific repair facility.

If you choose a repair facility that is not one of our preferred providers, your payment will be based on the reasonable amount it would cost to repair your vehicle at a preferred provider using like kind and quality parts. Any difference between that amount and the amount charged by the non-preferred facility is your responsibility.
Glass coverage is included with Comprehensive coverage. Our policy does not provide a special glass waiver unless required by law.
If we pay for a loss, we are entitled to recover our payment from any responsible party. You must do nothing to prejudice our right of recovery.
You must transfer to us your rights of recovery against any party responsible for the loss. You must do nothing after a loss to impair those rights.
Thank you for choosing Prairie Meridian Mutual. Please keep this policy with your important records.
